liveMeasurements.method: Playwright requestAnimationFrame sampling on hover; angle = atan2 of the computed transform matrix (360deg wraps to 0).
liveMeasurements.conclusion: Full 360deg spin in ~450-500ms, ease; clone matches live. Not in the saved export because Webflow applies it at runtime. Distinct from the logo-strip tiles, which do not rotate.
